description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of a ground surface composed of small, light-colored gravel or sand, interspersed with dark, irregularly shaped rocks. Among the rocks and gravel, various objects are scattered. A toothbrush with a turquoise handle and white bristles lies diagonally across the scene, partially resting on a rock. Nearby, there is a transparent plastic container with a slightly cloudy appearance, possibly containing water or debris, and it appears to be partially buried in the gravel
